svab-p01-v01.quick_english: Bow to all-bliss-made-of-freedom-giving, to Śiva, to quenched-all-becoming-path-darkness-sun.

svab-p01-v02.quick_english: Free from all-view-possession-sickness, to be felt by self-feeling, abiding in self — I praise supreme Śiva.

svab-p01-v03.quick_english: To shatterer of cast-off-fancy-net-fancy-floods, bow be to beyond-supreme-bliss-stage, to Śambhu.

svab-p01-v04.quick_english: They triumph — giving essence-nonessence-division in shoreless wandering, causes of freedom-knowing-awakening — Śambhu-feet.

svab-p01-v05.quick_english: Mind, intellect, I, breaths, subtle-sense-life — whom having seen they turn back, him to be worshipped we worship.

svab-p01-v06.quick_english: Mine-I thus — sole knife for heart-knot cutting, who made throb and throbless her morsel — I bow, I, pure awareness.

svab-p02-v07.quick_english: Of undesignated reality, how speaking? By true method of self-feeling, it is reached, if by anyone.

svab-p02-v08.quick_english: By teaching of knowing-yoga, of whom no inner trust — from being devoid of trust, how final-beatitude fruit?

svab-p02-v09.quick_english: Means to reaching the goal this: in self-awakening, wakefulness; from being wakeful in self-awakening, undivided standing of sage.

svab-p02-v10.quick_english: Means no other any, than following own being except; her just following, yogin abiding in self — who, he happy may be.

svab-p02-v11.quick_english: From grasping own concepts, from resorting to pure knowing, and from gaining supreme joy — awakening-one-mass-ness of sage.

svab-p02-v12.quick_english: When restrained own concepts, of power in powerful standing; of power and powerful oneness — thus to be reached, and, of yogins.

svab-p02-v13.quick_english: When attained own-form-knowing, when cast off reality-sheath, when scattered exertion-cause — freed he, tradition says, is called.

svab-p02-v14.quick_english: On awakening alone, grasp to be made by fully awake mind; so long until from own capacity, grounded in self, alone may be.

svab-p03-v15.quick_english: Always fully awake being, he sees self by self; of seer abiding in own form, what else remains?

svab-p03-v16.quick_english: Ever indeed fully-awake-ness: so much of mind wasting; from that wasting, of yogins true realization becomes enough.

svab-p03-v17.quick_english: Turned back, in self-awareness abides who but without duality; he emperor of yoked yogins, sun to ignorance-darkness.

svab-p03-v18.quick_english: Moon-state excelled by own-form-taste-joy; to be got what is here, of wasted inner sense, of me?

svab-p03-v19.quick_english: Self-understanding, rest — well firm, of whom, very clear; of him, freed from turnings, may be aloneness before long.

svab-p03-v20.quick_english: Whose one mind is dismissal of graspable-grasping-traces, of yogins grounded in own self — fortune of release not hard to win.

svab-p03-v21.quick_english: Gained own-form rest, ceased suffering-series; graspable-grasper-ness broken — abiding in own form am I, firm standing.

svab-p03-v22.quick_english: Nonduality-awakening-awakened-own-form-taste-state — risen or closed in, gains who, he reality-knower.

svab-p03-v23.quick_english: Of whom in all states self-standing never indeed is lost; of him what really do they do — scripture-wandering-confusions?

svab-p03-v24.quick_english: Whose self freed from delusion born of real-unreal fancy and real-unreal error — living even amid people, fear gone always, yogin.

svab-p04-v25.quick_english: Whose senses cast off, by whom absorption served once — supreme made face to face, by him whose aim done, by yogin.

svab-p04-v26.quick_english: In I-self unbroken, having gathered from own effort — awakened may be, grounded in self being, until Sadāśiva-splendor.

svab-p04-v27.quick_english: Whose turning partless, having cast all objects, knower once in own self who got the getting — whose sole aim right awakening, grounded in self — own sheath, indeed, abandons yogin.

svab-p04-v28.quick_english: Whose true method is word and taste, of whom is unbroken in self-awareness — his teaching-making fit among pupils: awakening rightly.

svab-p04-v29.quick_english: From desirelessness, from self-awakening, from leaving of hope and pride, from cutting real-unreal steps — not again body-grasping.

svab-p04-v30.quick_english: Whose inner sense trusting, whose fancies wasted, delighting in own-form gain, sated with nectar of self-taste — freedom goes to, whose aim done.

svab-p04-v31.quick_english: Thus for reaching the goal — stainless, consciousness-lighting, true, mothering freedom-becoming — self-awakening-accomplishment by me told.

svab-p04-v32.quick_english: By which teaching, un-got-getting becomes enough, freed from doubt fault — by this doubtless teaching, what really should do much-scripture-reciter?

svab-p04-v33.quick_english: Making whole benison, forest-fire to manifold deeds, showing own-form state, free from all fancy, temple of all joy — for cutting manifold suffering root, I bow to peerless-lovely, taught by guru mouth, Śiva.

svab-p01-v01.inference: The bow goes to the freedom-giver: Śiva, sun that quenched the darkness of the becoming-road.
premises: Bow (opening obeisance).
All-bliss-made-of, freedom-giving (the gift characterized).
Śiva: the quenched-all-becoming-path-darkness sun (the recipient imaged).

svab-p01-v01.speaker: Devotee (praising)

svab-p01-v02.speaker: Devotee (praising)

svab-p01-v03.inference: The bow goes to Śambhu: shatterer of the fancy-net, beyond even the supreme-bliss stage.

Bow, be (the benedictory imperative).
To Śambhu beyond the supreme-bliss stage (the recipient placed past attainment).

svab-p01-v03.speaker: Devotee (praising)

Giving essence-nonessence division in shoreless saṃsāra (the discriminating act).
Causes of freedom-knowing-awakening (the fruit caused).
svab-p01-v04.question: What triumphs?
svab-p01-v04.speaker: Devotee (praising)

Him, to be worshipped, we worship (the communal seal).
svab-p01-v05.question: Whom do we worship?
svab-p01-v05.speaker: Devotee (praising)

svab-p01-v06.inference: I bow to pure awareness: sole knife for the mine-I heart-knot, devourer of throb and throbless.
premises: Mine-I thus (the knot named).
Sole knife for heart-knot cutting (the instrument).
Who made throb and throbless her morsel (spanda-aspanda devoured).
svab-p01-v06.question: To what do I bow?
svab-p01-v06.speaker: Devotee (praising)

premises: Reality is undesignated (beyond vyapadeśa).

svab-p02-v07.question: How speak the undescribed?
svab-p02-v07.speaker: Teacher (questioning)

svab-p02-v08.speaker: Teacher (warning)

From wakefulness: the sage's undivided standing.

premises: Whose true method is word and taste (the qualification).
Unbroken in self-awareness (the standing).
His teaching fit among pupils: awakening rightly (the license).
svab-p04-v28.question: Who may teach?
svab-p04-v28.speaker: Teacher (licensing)

svab-p04-v29.inference: From desirelessness, self-awakening, leaving hope-pride, cutting real-unreal — no more body-grasping.
premises: From desirelessness, from self-awakening (the double source).
From leaving hope and pride, from cutting real-unreal steps (the double act).
Not again body-grasping (the no-rebirth seal).
svab-p04-v29.question: What ends rebirth?
svab-p04-v29.speaker: Teacher (sealing)

svab-p04-v30.inference: Inner sense trusting, fancies wasted, own-form delight, nectar-sated — he reaches freedom, aim done.
premises: Inner sense trusting, fancies wasted (the clearance).
Delighting in own-form gain, sated with self-taste nectar (the ripeness).
Goes to freedom, aim done (the arrival).
svab-p04-v30.question: Who reaches freedom?
svab-p04-v30.speaker: Teacher (arriving)

svab-p04-v31.inference: Thus for the goal: stainless, consciousness-lighting, true, freedom-mothering — the self-awakening-accomplishment told by me.
premises: Thus for reaching the goal (the purpose).
Stainless, consciousness-lighting, true, freedom-mothering (the fourfold praise).
By me told (the authorship voice, identity unasserted).
svab-p04-v31.question: What was told?
svab-p04-v31.speaker: Author (colophoning)

svab-p04-v32.inference: Where this teaching suffices, doubt purged — what use has the much-reciter?
premises: By which teaching the un-got becomes enough, doubt-fault freed (the sufficiency).
By this doubtless teaching (the instrument).
What should the much-scripture-reciter do? (the rhetorical dismissal).
svab-p04-v32.question: What use scriptures?
svab-p04-v32.speaker: Teacher (dismissing)

svab-p04-v33.inference: Whole-benison, deed-fire, own-form-shower, fancy-free, joy-temple — I bow to guru-mouth-taught lovely Śiva, cutter of suffering's root.
premises: Whole benison, deed-fire, own-form-shower, fancy-free, joy-temple (the fivefold praise).
For cutting manifold suffering's root (the purpose).
Guru-mouth-taught, peerless-lovely Śiva bowed to (the lineage seal).
svab-p04-v33.question: To whom the final bow?
svab-p04-v33.speaker: Devotee (bowing)

svab-p01-v01.plain_english: Bow to the giver of freedom, made of every blessing — to Śiva, the sun that burnt away the darkness on every road of becoming.

svab-p01-v02.plain_english: I praise the highest Śiva — sick with no possession by any creed, to be known only by the feeling of the self, dwelling in himself.
svab-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣadarśanāveśaviśeṣādhivivarjitam / svasaṃvedanasaṃvedyaṃ svasthaṃ vande paraṃ śivam

svab-p01-v03.plain_english: Bow, let there be bow, to Śambhu — smasher of the net of fancies and their floods, standing past even the highest bliss.

svab-p01-v04.plain_english: Victorious are Śambhu's feet: they teach the wandering world to tell the real from the sham, and wake the knowledge that frees.

svab-p01-v05.plain_english: Mind, thought, ego, breaths, the senses' subtle fuel and life — all turn back when they see the one worth worshipping, whom we worship.
svab-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: mano buddhir ahaṃ prāṇās tanmātrendriyajīvanam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinivartante tam upāsyam upāsmahe

svab-p01-v06.plain_english: I bow — I — to pure awareness: the only knife that cuts the heart's knot of 'mine' and 'I', that swallowed throbbing and its stillness both.
svab-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: mamāham iti hṛdgranthicchedanaikakṛpāṇikām / spandāspandakṛtagrāsāṃ naumy ahaṃ śuddhasaṃvidam

svab-p02-v07.plain_english: How tell what cannot be named? If anyone reaches it at all, it is by the honest method of feeling oneself.
svab-p02-v07.sanskrit_cite: vyapadeśavihīnasya tattvasya kathanaṃ katham / svasaṃvedanasadyuktyā gamyate yadi kenacit

svab-p02-v08.plain_english: Taught the yoga of knowing, yet with no trust inside — trustless, how could he ever taste freedom's fruit?
svab-p02-v08.sanskrit_cite: jñānayogopadeśena yasya nāśvāsa āntaraḥ / samāśvāsavihīnatvāt kathaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ phalam

svab-p02-v09.plain_english: The way to the goal is this: stay awake in your own awakening. From such waking the sage stands whole, undivided.
svab-p02-v09.sanskrit_cite: upeyaprāptyupāyo 'yaṃ svabodhe jāgarūkatā / svabodhajāgarūkatvān nirvibhāgā sthitir muneḥ

svab-p02-v10.plain_english: No way but keeping to your own being. Keep to her, rest in yourself — whoever does is happy.
svab-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: upāyo nāparaḥ kaścit svasattānugamād ṛte / tām evānusaran yogī svastho yaḥ sa sukhī bhavet

svab-p02-v11.plain_english: From noticing your own notions, from holding to pure knowing, from winning the highest joy — the sage grows one solid mass of waking.
svab-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: svasaṃkalpaparāmarśād viśuddhajñānasaṃśrayāt / paramāhlādalābhāc ca bodhaikaghanatā muneḥ

svab-p02-v12.plain_english: Grip your notions still, and power comes to rest in the powerful; their oneness is what yogis are after.
svab-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: nigṛhīte svasaṃkalpe śakteḥ śaktimati sthitiḥ / śaktiśaktimator aikyam ity upeyaṃ ca yoginām

svab-p02-v13.plain_english: Know your own form, drop the veil of principles, scatter the cause of striving — then, tradition says, you are called free.
svab-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: prāpte svarūpavijñāne santyakte tattvakañcuke / udyogakāraṇe kīrṇe muktaḥ sa kila kathyate

svab-p02-v14.plain_english: With a fully wakened mind, hold to waking alone — until, by your own strength, you stand in yourself, alone.
svab-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: bodhamātre grahaḥ kāryaḥ suprabuddhena cetasā / tāvad yāvat svasāmarthyāt svaniṣṭhaḥ kevalo bhavet

svab-p03-v15.plain_english: Ever fully awake, he sees himself by himself; for the seer settled in his own form, what else is left?
svab-p03-v15.sanskrit_cite: sarvadā suprabuddhas san paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā / draṣṭuḥ svarūpasaṃsthasya kim anyad avaśiṣyate

svab-p03-v16.plain_english: To be always fully awake is for the mind to waste away; from that wasting, yogis truly see.
svab-p03-v16.sanskrit_cite: sadaiva suprabuddhatvam etāvan manasaḥ kṣayaḥ / tatkṣayād yogināṃ samyaksākṣātkāro bhavaty alam

svab-p03-v17.plain_english: Turned back into self-awareness, with no twoness left — he is king among yogis, a sun against the dark of ignorance.
svab-p03-v17.sanskrit_cite: paryāvṛttaḥ svasaṃvittau vartate yas tv abhedataḥ / sa samrāḍ yogayuktānām ajñānadhvāntabhāskaraḥ

svab-p03-v18.plain_english: The moon pales before the joy of tasting your own nature; with the inner organ gone, what is there left for me to get?
svab-p03-v18.sanskrit_cite: svarūpānubhavāhlādadaśātītendusaṃsthitiḥ / avāptavyaṃ kim astīha kṣīṇāntaḥkaraṇasya me

svab-p03-v19.plain_english: Self-knowledge and rest, firm and bright, for whoever holds them; freed from the mind's whirl, aloneness comes soon.
svab-p03-v19.sanskrit_cite: svaparijñaptiviśrāntī sudṛḍhe yasya susphuṭe / tasya vṛttivimuktasya bhavet kevalatācirāt

svab-p03-v20.plain_english: For yogis grounded in themselves, whose single mind sweeps aside the traces of grasping and the grasped — fortune's release is easy.
svab-p03-v20.sanskrit_cite: grāhyagrahaṇasaṃskāratiraskāraikacetasām / yogināṃ svātmaniṣṭhānāṃ mokṣalakṣmīr na durlabhā

svab-p03-v21.plain_english: Rest in my own form I have won, my sorrows ended, the split of grasped and grasper broken — I stand firm, abiding as I am.
svab-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: labdhā svarūpaviśrāntir nirvṛttā kleśasantatiḥ / grāhyagrāhakatā bhagnā svarūpastho' smi saṃsthitaḥ

svab-p03-v22.plain_english: Whether up and about or gathered inward, whoever wins that nondual, wakened taste of his own nature knows what is real.
svab-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: abhedabodhasaṃbodhasvarūpānubhavasthitim / vyutthitaḥ sanniruddho vā labhate yaḥ sa tattvavit

svab-p03-v23.plain_english: For one whose self-standing never slips in any state — what can the squabbles of scripture-rangers do to him?
svab-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: yasya sarvāsv avasthāsu svasthitir naiva lupyate / tasya kiṃ nāma kurvanti śāstrabhramaṇavibhramāḥ

svab-p03-v24.plain_english: His self freed from the delusion brewed of real and unreal notions — he lives on among people, fear gone, always a yogi.
svab-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: vigalitasadasadvikalpasadasadbhramajanitamohamuktātmā / jīvann api janamadhye vigatabhayaḥ sarvadā yogī

svab-p04-v25.plain_english: Senses cast off, having sat with absorption even once — the highest stands face to face with the yogi whose work is done.
svab-p04-v25.sanskrit_cite: nirastakaraṇo yena samādhiḥ sevitaḥ sakṛt / paraḥ sākṣātkṛtas tena caritārthena yoginā

svab-p04-v26.plain_english: Unbroken in the I-self, gathered by his own effort — may he wake, and stand in himself, till he shines as Sadāśiva.
svab-p04-v26.sanskrit_cite: ahamātmany asambhinnaḥ saṃgṛhya svaprayatnataḥ / prabuddhaḥ syāt svaniṣṭhaḥ san yāvat sādāśivadyutiḥ

svab-p04-v27.plain_english: His turning partless, all objects dropped, the knower who won the winning, aimed at waking alone, standing in himself — indeed he casts off his own sheath, the yogi.
svab-p04-v27.sanskrit_cite: nirastasarvārthaniraṃśavṛttir jñānī sakṛt svātmani labdhalābhaḥ / samyaṅnibodhaikaparaḥ svaniṣṭhaḥ svakañcukaṃ hanta jahāti yogī

svab-p04-v28.plain_english: Whose honest method is the word and the taste, unbroken in self-awareness — he is fit to make teaching, and to wake pupils rightly.
svab-p04-v28.sanskrit_cite: vāganubhavasadyuktir yasyāsti nirantaraṃ svasaṃvittau / tasyopadeśakaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ śiṣyeṣu bodhanaṃ samyak

svab-p04-v29.plain_english: From wanting nothing, from self-waking, from dropping hope and pride, from cutting the road of real-and-unreal — no taking of a body again.
svab-p04-v29.sanskrit_cite: nairvāsanyāt svasaṃbodhāt tyāgād āśābhimānayoḥ / sadasatpadavicchedān na punar vigrahagrahaḥ

svab-p04-v30.plain_english: Inner sense at peace, fancies thinned, delighting in the gain of his own form, drunk on the nectar of tasting himself — he goes to freedom, his work done.
svab-p04-v30.sanskrit_cite: āśvastāntaḥkaraṇaḥ kṣīṇavikalpaḥ svarūpalābharataḥ / svānubhavāmṛtatṛptaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti caritārthaḥ

svab-p04-v31.plain_english: So, for reaching the goal — stainless, lighting consciousness, true, mother of freedom's rise — I have told the perfection of self-waking.
svab-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: ittham upeyaprāptau vigatamalā citprakāśikā satyā / kaivalyabhūtijananī svabodhasiddhir mayā gaditā

svab-p04-v32.plain_english: This teaching can make even one who never won enough, and free him from doubt's fault — with such doubtless teaching, what business has the much-chanting scholar?
svab-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: yenopadeśena nalabdhalābho bhavaty alaṃ saṃśayadoṣamuktaḥ / tenopadeśena nasaṃśayena kiṃ nāma kuryād bahuśāstrapāṭhī

svab-p04-v33.plain_english: All-blessing maker, wildfire to tangled deeds, shower of your own station, free of every notion, temple of all joy — to cut suffering's root I bow to the unmatchably lovely Śiva, taught from the guru's mouth.
svab-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣakṛtamaṅgalaṃ vividhakarmadāvānalaṃ svarūpapadadarśakaṃ sakalakalpanāvarjitam / samastasukhamandiraṃ vividhaduḥkhamūlacchide namāmy asamasundaraṃ gurumukhopadiṣṭaṃ śivam

essence: Bow to the freedom-giver: Śiva, sun against becoming-darkness.
Highest praised: view-sickness-free, self-feeling-known, self-abiding.
Bow to Śambhu: fancy-net smasher, past supreme-bliss stage.
Feet triumph: essence divided from nonessence, awakening caused.
All faculties turn back before the worship-worthy we worship.
I bow to pure awareness: sole knife for the mine-I knot.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder settling into quiescence)
rasa.justification: Wonder at the praised Lord — sun, smasher, triumphant feet, retreating faculties — settles by v6 into pure awareness, knife-still; praise becomes quiescence before method begins.

sections.BOUNDARY: No method is taught; the question of speaking the undescribed belongs to the teaching that follows.
sections.EXPLANATION: Six bows, four verbs of bowing (namaḥ, vande, namo 'stu, naumi, upāsmahe): freedom given whole-blessinged; theology-possession refused; fancy-nets smashed past bliss; feet dividing real from sham; all faculties retreating before the worship-worthy; pure awareness knifing the mine-I knot and devouring throb and throbless.
sections.FUNCTION: Establishes whom the teaching comes from and what it cuts, before any method is taught.
sections.KEY TERMS: namaḥ/vande/namo 'stu/naumi (bowing verbs) — fourfold praise; kaivalya (freedom) — the gift; svasaṃvedana (self-feeling) — known only thus; svastha (self-abiding) — the praised state; āveśa (possession-sickness) — refused; spanda-aspanda (throb and throbless) — devoured; hṛdgranthi (heart-knot) — mine-and-I, knifed.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The six praises pledge the doctrine's source and temper; method and fruit taught beyond answer to this Lord.
sections.RELATED: Hanneder codex unicus (ZDMG 2017); Bhūti(rāja) ascription cautious, identity unasserted; self-feeling axis planted here, guarded throughout.
sections.SUMMARY: Freedom given, views refused, fancies smashed, feet triumphant, faculties retreating, awareness knifed clean — six bows name their Lord whole-blessing, past-bliss, theology-free, worship-worthy, mine-I-cutting.

essence: Undesignated reality: spoken only by self-feeling's true method.
Teaching without inner trust: no final fruit.
Means: wakefulness in self-awakening; sage stands undivided.
No means but following own being; follower abides, happy.
Concept-grasping, pure knowing, supreme joy: one-mass awakening.
Concepts restrained: power rests in powerful; oneness the goal.
Form known, sheath cast, striving scattered: called freed.
Fully-awake mind grasps awakening alone till grounded-alone.

rasa.justification: The prescriptions demand heroic holding — wakefulness kept, concepts gripped still, grasp held alone — yet every verb stills: restrained, cast off, scattered. Resolve serves quiescence, never agitates it.

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is described; the fruit's first-person seal belongs to the standing that follows.
sections.EXPLANATION: Question and answer: how speak the undescribed (by self-feeling's method); what without trust (no fruit). Thesis: wakefulness in self-awakening (ms. locative kept), no means but following own being. Ladder: concepts grasped, knowing purified, joy won — one-mass awakening; concepts restrained — power in powerful; form known, sheath cast, striving scattered — freed; grasp held on awakening alone till grounded-alone from own capacity.
sections.FUNCTION: Answers the opening question with the single method, then walks its stages to the freed name.
sections.KEY TERMS: svasaṃvedana-sadyukti (self-feeling's true method) — the only access; āśvāsa (trust) — without it, no fruit; jāgarūkatā (wakefulness) — the method; svasattānugama (following own being) — the sole exception; bodhaikaghanatā (one-mass awakening) — the ripening; śakti/śaktimat (power/powerful) — oneness the goal; bodhamātra (awakening alone) — the axis guarded.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The method pledged here pays out across the fruit: wakefulness-words return in every later standing.
sections.RELATED: Hanneder ms. readings kept (svabodhe, sukhī, kīrṇe, mātre); Sanderson's nine stanzas edited earlier; bodha-vs-jñāna axis guarded throughout.
sections.SUMMARY: Speaking needs self-feeling's method; trustless teaching bears nothing. One means: wakefulness in self-awakening, following own being and nothing else. Concepts grasped, knowing purified, joy won — awakening masses whole; power rests in the powerful. Form known, sheath dropped, striving scattered: freed. Hold waking alone till grounded-alone.

essence: Always awake: self seen by self; nothing else remains.
Ever-wakefulness: mind wastes; thence true seeing.
Turned back without duality: emperor, sun to ignorance-dark.
Moon eclipsed by own-form joy; inner sense gone: nothing to get.
Understanding and rest firm and clear: aloneness soon.
Grasp-traces dismissed, self-grounded: release easy.
Rest gained, sorrows ceased, grasper broken: I stand firm in own form.
Risen or absorbed, winner of the nondual taste knows reality.
Self-standing never lost: scripture-squabbles do nothing.
Delusion-freed, living amid people, fear gone: yogin free.

rasa.justification: Seeing without remainder, mind wasted, emperor still, moon eclipsed, understanding at rest, release easy, grasper broken, scriptures impotent, fear gone — every verse stills. Even the first-person seal stands firm rather than exults.

sections.BOUNDARY: No instruction is given; who may teach and what ends rebirth belong to the closing that follows.
sections.EXPLANATION: The fruit in third person then first: always-awake seeing with nothing over; wakefulness equated with mind-wasting, wasting with true seeing; turned back without duality — emperor and sun; moon eclipsed by own-form joy with inner sense gone; understanding and rest firm — aloneness soon; grasp-traces dismissed — release easy; rest gained, sorrows ceased, grasper broken — I stand firm; risen or absorbed — the winner knows; self-standing never lost — scriptures do nothing; delusion shed amid people, fear gone — free while living.
sections.FUNCTION: States the fruit in the third person, then seals it in the first: freedom described, then owned.
sections.KEY TERMS: suprabuddhatva (fully-awake-ness) — equated with mind-wasting; manaskṣaya (mind-wasting) — the equation's hinge; samrāṭ (emperor) — crowned stillness; kevalatā (aloneness) — the near fruit; mokṣalakṣmī (release's fortune) — easy; svarūpastha (abiding in own form) — the first-person seal, refrain-candidate; tattvavit (reality-knower) — risen or absorbed; śāstrabhramaṇa (scripture-wandering) — impotent; vigatabhaya (fear gone) — the standing mark.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The wakefulness-method taught before flowers here into standing, seeing, reigning — third person ripening into first.
sections.RELATED: v21 first-person seal flagged for song-setting; v22a silent conjecture followed; Sanderson's nine include vv22-24.
sections.SUMMARY: Always awake sees self by self; waking wastes mind, and wasting yields true seeing. Turned back without duality: emperor, sun. Moon pales before own-form joy; understanding and rest stand firm; release comes easy. Rest gained, sorrows ended, grasper snapped — I stand firm in own form. Risen or gathered, the winner knows; scriptures cannot touch him. Delusion shed, he lives among people, fear gone — free while living.

essence: Senses cast off, absorption once served: supreme faced.
Unbroken in I-self, own effort: awakened till Sadāśiva-splendor.
Turning partless, gain gained: indeed the sheath abandoned.
Word-and-taste his method: fit to awaken pupils.
Desirelessness, self-waking, no hope-pride, no real-unreal road: no rebirth.
Sense at peace, nectar-sated: freedom reached, aim done.
Thus told: stainless, consciousness-lighting, true, freedom-mothering accomplishment.
Teaching enough for unwinners, doubt purged: no use for much-reciters.
Final bow: whole-benison, deed-fire, joy-temple Śiva, guru-mouth-taught.

rasa.justification: Instruction stills (senses cast, sheath dropped, no rebirth), the colophon tells without stirring, and the final bow bends quiescence into devotion — guru-mouth-taught loveliness praised, not argued.

sections.BOUNDARY: Nothing new is taught after the thirtieth; the colophon tells, dismisses, and bows.
sections.EXPLANATION: Instruction closed: senses cast off with absorption once served — supreme faced; unbroken in I-self by own effort — awakened till Sadāśiva-splendor; turning partless, gain gained — indeed the sheath falls; word-and-taste his method — fit to wake pupils rightly; desirelessness, self-waking, hope-pride dropped, real-unreal road cut — no body again; sense at peace, nectar-sated — freedom, aim done. Colophon: stainless, consciousness-lighting, true, freedom-mothering accomplishment told by me; teaching enough for unwinners, doubt purged — no use for much-reciters. Benediction: whole-blessing, deed-fire, own-form-shower, fancy-free, joy-temple — bow for suffering-root cutting to guru-mouth-taught lovely Śiva.
sections.FUNCTION: Seals instruction, names the work, dismisses mere learning, and bows through the guru's mouth.
sections.KEY TERMS: sākṣātkṛta (made face to face) — once suffices; sādāśivadyuti (Sadāśiva-splendor) — the open horizon; hanta (indeed) — commended abandonment; vāg-anubhava (word-and-taste) — the teacher's license; nairvāsanya (desirelessness) — with self-waking; kaivalya (freedom) — reached, aim done; bahuśāstrapāṭhin (much-scripture-reciter) — dismissed; gurumukha (guru's mouth) — the lineage seal.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The closing pays every pledge: waking becomes splendor, trust becomes doubtlessness, views become dismissed reciters.
sections.RELATED: Title-verse names the work (authorship voice kept literal, identity unasserted); guru-mouth lineage claimed in closing; Krama and Mokṣopāya parallels open per Hanneder.
sections.SUMMARY: Senses dropped, absorption once tasted: the supreme face to face. Unbroken in the I-self, gathered by own effort — wake till Sadāśiva-splendor. Turning partless, gain won: indeed the sheath falls. Word-and-taste his method: fit to wake pupils. Desirelessness, self-waking, hope and pride dropped, real-unreal road cut: no body again. Sense at peace, nectar-drunk: freedom, aim done. Thus told — stainless, consciousness-lighting, true, freedom's mother. The never-winner made enough: what use the much-reciter? Final bow: whole-blessing, deed-fire, joy-temple, guru-mouth-taught lovely Śiva.

lines: Bow to the freedom-giver, made of every bliss —
to Śiva, the sun that cleared the becoming's abyss.
I praise the highest Śiva — by no creed possessed,
known only in self-feeling, in himself at rest.
svab-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣadarśanāveśaviśeṣādhivivarjitam / svasaṃvedanasaṃvedyaṃ svasthaṃ vande paraṃ śivam

lines: Bow, let it be a bow, to Śambhu — who broke
the net of fancy and its floods — past bliss itself.
Victorious, Śambhu's feet — through the shoreless sea
they part the real from sham, and wake the knowing free.
Mind, thought, and I, breaths, senses' subtle store —
they turn back, seeing him — the worship-worthy we adore.
svab-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: mano buddhir ahaṃ prāṇās tanmātrendriyajīvanam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinivartante tam upāsyam upāsmahe

lines: I bow — I — to pure awareness, sole knife-blade
for the heart-knot of mine-and-I, that ate up throb and stillness.

lines: How speak a thing no sign can show? If it is won,
it is won by feeling self — by that method alone.
svab-p02-v07.sanskrit_cite: vyapadeśavihīnasya tattvasya kathanaṃ katham / svasaṃvedanasadyuktyā gamyate yadi kenacit

trustless, how should he ever freedom win?

lines: The way is this: in self-waking stay awake;
from waking so, the sage stands whole, no part to break.

rest in self — the follower is glad.

the sage grows one dense mass of waking.

their oneness is the yogis' prize.

then, says the old word, you are freed indeed.

till by your own strength you stand in self, alone.

settled in his own form — what remains else?

from that waste, yogis truly see.

he stands king of the yoked, sun to ignorance-dark.

sense gone within — what more is there than this?

whirlings shed, aloneness dawns in sight.
svab-p03-v19.sanskrit_cite: svaparijñaptiviśrāntī sudṛḍhe yasya susphuṭe / tasya vṛttivimuktasya bhavet kevalatācirāt

grounded in self, release lies easy to his hand.

grasper and grasped broke — I stand firm in my own form.

risen or inward-gathered, knows the Real itself.
svab-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: abhedabodhasaṃbodhasvarūpānubhavasthitim / vyutthitaḥ sanniruddho vā labhate yaḥ sa tattvavit

lines: Whose self-stand slips in no state, high or low —
what can the scripture-wanderers' stirrings do?

lines: Delusion shed — born of real-and-unreal strife —
he lives among men still, fearless: yogi in life.
svab-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: vigalitasadasadvikalpasadasadbhramajanitamohamuktātmā / jīvann api janamadhye vigatabhayaḥ sarvadā yogī

lines: Senses cast, one session served — the Supreme
stands face to face with him whose task's complete.
svab-p04-v25.sanskrit_cite: nirastakaraṇo yena samādhiḥ sevitaḥ sakṛt / paraḥ sākṣātkṛtas tena caritārthena yoginā

lines: Unbroken in the I-self, gathered by his toil —
wake and stand in self, till Sadāśiva-splendor.
svab-p04-v26.sanskrit_cite: ahamātmany asambhinnaḥ saṃgṛhya svaprayatnataḥ / prabuddhaḥ syāt svaniṣṭhaḥ san yāvat sādāśivadyutiḥ

lines: His turning whole, all objects put behind —
the winner, waking-aimed: his sheath cast off, indeed.
svab-p04-v27.sanskrit_cite: nirastasarvārthaniraṃśavṛttir jñānī sakṛt svātmani labdhalābhaḥ / samyaṅnibodhaikaparaḥ svaniṣṭhaḥ svakañcukaṃ hanta jahāti yogī

lines: His method word and taste, unbroken self-aware —
his teaching stands fit: pupils wakened right.
svab-p04-v28.sanskrit_cite: vāganubhavasadyuktir yasyāsti nirantaraṃ svasaṃvittau / tasyopadeśakaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ śiṣyeṣu bodhanaṃ samyak

lines: From craving-free, self-waked, hope-pride foregone,
real-unreal roads cut — no flesh put on.
svab-p04-v29.sanskrit_cite: nairvāsanyāt svasaṃbodhāt tyāgād āśābhimānayoḥ / sadasatpadavicchedān na punar vigrahagrahaḥ

lines: Inner sense trusting, fancies thinned and spent,
self-form his joy, self-nectar-drunk — freedom, aim content.
svab-p04-v30.sanskrit_cite: āśvastāntaḥkaraṇaḥ kṣīṇavikalpaḥ svarūpalābharataḥ / svānubhavāmṛtatṛptaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti caritārthaḥ

lines: Thus for the goal — stainless, spirit-bright,
mother of freedom: self-waking, as told by me.

lines: This teaching fills the unfilled, clears doubt's stain —
what should much-chanting scholars still attain?
svab-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: yenopadeśena nalabdhalābho bhavaty alaṃ saṃśayadoṣamuktaḥ / tenopadeśena nasaṃśayena kiṃ nāma kuryād bahuśāstrapāṭhī

lines: Whole-blessing maker, wildfire to deeds, showing own form,
fancy-free, all-joy's temple — I bow to Śiva, guru-mouth-taught, lovely past compare.
svab-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣakṛtamaṅgalaṃ vividhakarmadāvānalaṃ svarūpapadadarśakaṃ sakalakalpanāvarjitam / samastasukhamandiraṃ vividhaduḥkhamūlacchide namāmy asamasundaraṃ gurumukhopadiṣṭaṃ śivam

lines: Bow to the freedom-giver, made of every bliss:
to Śiva — the sun that cleared the becoming's abyss.
I praise the highest Śiva — by no creed possessed,

svab-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣadarśanāveśaviśeṣādhivivarjitam / svasaṃvedanasaṃvedyaṃ svasthaṃ vande paraṃ śivam

lines: Bow — let it be a bow — to Śambhu, who broke
the net of fancy and its floods, past bliss itself.
Victorious, Śambhu's feet! Through the shoreless sea

Mind, thought, and I, breaths, senses' subtle store:
they turn back seeing him — the worship-worthy we adore.
